what: the motion source contract, replayed against the Target's own recorded input
contractIsSourceRead: Every constant in the contract was read out of the Target's application bundle. Nothing here fits a constant to a curve; this file only asks whether the source model reproduces the Target, and reports where it does not.

targetRepeatability.method: the same trajectory run 3 times, resampled onto the first run's frame times, worst pointwise spread across the runs

modelVsTarget.trajectoryExcludedWhy: a resize re-tiles the grid mid-run, so the recovered trajectory is re-seeded and a pointwise residual across that boundary measures the re-seed. Judged on continuity instead; see resizeContinuity.
modelVsTarget.timeShiftNote: A single constant time offset per run, reported rather than applied: the recorder's own frame callback, the page's render callback and the gesture dispatch are three different points in one frame, so a sub-frame phase difference is expected and is not a property of the model. The raw residual is the headline; the aligned one says how much of it is phase.

modelResidualAgainstTargetNoise.what: the model's worst residual beside the Target's own spread, per sequence
